counterplay_veto.rationale: A contest most responders cannot legally pay for is a coronation, not counterplay. Offered rates and purse shares come from tools/contest_audit.py re-runs of every suite game. The baseline-purse guard asks: of the response purses observed under the fee-1 incumbent, what share could pay the candidate's contest fee? Fee 2 failed live play exactly here (responders held 0 or 1 Prestige).
